# ShardBeats TRAKK SUITE

> Six free, offline, open-source tools for beatmakers: convert sample libraries to WAV for the Roland SP-404MK2, peak-normalize clips, generate beat titles, render beats to 1080p video, and produce beat license contracts as PDF. Portable Windows executables. No accounts, no cloud, no subscriptions. MIT licensed.

Canonical site: https://shardbeats.github.io/tools/
Spanish version: https://shardbeats.github.io/tools/
English version: https://shardbeats.github.io/tools/en/
Last updated: 2026-11-10
Author: Dario Garcia (Shard Btmkr), La Piedad, Mich., Mexico
Source: https://github.com/shardbeats

## Tools

- [TRAKKSTUDIO](https://shardbeats.github.io/tools/trakkstudio/) — Organize, convert to SP-404MK2 WAV and peak-normalize in one window. [English](https://shardbeats.github.io/tools/en/trakkstudio/) · Source: https://github.com/shardbeats/TRAKKSTUDIO
- [TRAKKCONVERTER](https://shardbeats.github.io/tools/trakkconverter/) — Batch-convert sample libraries to WAV compatible with the Roland SP-404MK2 (48 kHz, 16-bit, stereo). [English](https://shardbeats.github.io/tools/en/trakkconverter/) · Source: https://github.com/shardbeats/TRAKKCONVERTER
- [TRAKKNORMALIZER](https://shardbeats.github.io/tools/trakknormalizer/) — Per-clip peak normalization with linear gain, no compression. [English](https://shardbeats.github.io/tools/en/trakknormalizer/) · Source: https://github.com/shardbeats/TRAKKNORMALIZER
- [TRAKKNAME](https://shardbeats.github.io/tools/trakkname/) — Beat title generator by artist, genre and mood (EN/ES). Android build also available. [English](https://shardbeats.github.io/tools/en/trakkname/) · Source: https://github.com/shardbeats/TRAKKNAME
- [TRAKKOUT](https://shardbeats.github.io/tools/trakkout/) — Turn a beat and artwork into a 1080p MP4 for YouTube via FFmpeg, with templates and scheduled publishing. [English](https://shardbeats.github.io/tools/en/trakkout/) · Source: https://github.com/shardbeats/TRAKKOUT
- [TRAKKLICENSE](https://shardbeats.github.io/tools/trakklicense/) — Generate beat license contracts as PDF (EN/ES) with sequential folios and SHA256 evidence, offline. [English](https://shardbeats.github.io/tools/en/trakklicense/) · Source: https://github.com/shardbeats/TRAKKLICENSE
